mainEntity.name: Where do the delivery-time differences with gravity.integration come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: gravity.integration replaces hand-coded connections with a visual flow editor and ready-made integration atoms. The IntelliChain technology lets you build complex integrations in minutes rather than days.
The software is free for testing. A commercial licence is 799 EUR net per year for a single use case, or 1,799 EUR for an unlimited number of connections.

mainEntity.name: Can I test gravity for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You download the full version with no functional restrictions. You can test for as long as you like.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can my team get gravity running?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installation takes about 15 minutes. Fully deploying your first connection takes 1-4 working days.

mainEntity.name: Does gravity.integration integrate with my ERP, MES or WMS?

acceptedAnswer.text: gravity.integration connects to any system that exposes an API, a database, files or communication protocols.

mainEntity.name: What if I need more than one instance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every licence covers one instance with an unlimited number of users. Additional instances require separate licences.
